newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gasoline, gas oil sales hit record for Nov.
newsitem.headline: Japan gasoline, gas oil sales hit record for Nov.

text.p: Domestic sales of oil products used as fuel for transportation in November hit record highs for the month, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Wednesday.
Sales of gasoline, gas oil and jet fuel amounted to 4.4 million kilolitres (kl), 3.9 million kl and 417,000 kl, respectively, all record highs for a November, MITI said.
Overall sales of oil products in November were unchanged from the same period a year earlier, due to falls in sales of naphtha and kerosene, MITI said.
Naphtha sales slipped 4.7 percent year-on-year to 3.6 million kl, as petrochemical product makers switched to using more crude instead of naphtha, MITI said.
November sales of kerosene fell 2.4 percent year-on-year to 2.89 million kilolitres, MITI said.
